has.review:
Course: EEE452
Faculty: Dr. M. Rokonuzzaman (RKZ)
 Rokonuzzaman Sir is a very professional faculty. I mean, he is highly qualified as a faculty member and knows a lot of stuff. He seems to have knowledge about almost every technological revolution there has been, along with the rise and fall of different technologies and companies, going all the way back to the early days of those technologies. As old-school faculties tend to be, RKZ… See more

S M Tanvir Akram
Farhan Khan Chowdhury
Jalis Mahamud Yes no doubt sir is really knowledgeable person.
The only reason why he actually made this course is something you will understand once you graduate.

PastelCamel3506 you just have to memorize the slides and the answers have to be concise. Follow his instructions. Shurute ektu overwhelming lagte pare. But mid porjonto ektu patience niye porle erpor er content gulo familiar mone hobe. He has his unique formula for curving. Average er cheye better score korle bhalo grade ashbe.

Bad personality, arrogant, egoistic, Bad teacher. He has some minimal and common knowledge and present it in a ted talk way so that it seems and sound amazing.
Full semester he will say he appreciates Analytical Questions, Deep thinking etc. But in exams ask for hard memorization question like in the 3rd grade. Full semester you will feel like you are back in primary school, just memorize everything and vomiting. If you miss even 1 line the marks will be deducted. I tracked 2 sections containing 100+ students of 452. The highest marks:
Mid: 25-31/50, avg:22-24
Final: 37/50,
Quizzes: 10-14/20
He does this intentionally, makes hardest questions so no one can get full marks, you can feel it at the end. In 482 project, he asks irrelevant questions and gives imaginary marks because he does not have practical skills, I witnessed a job holder full stack dev getting 4/10 in the project LOL.

He doesn't push you to memorise graphs, but gives you real life illustrations with maths which help you to understand the graphs. And his grading system is quite a mixed bag. If the number of students with poor marks is high, then there is a chance that you might end up with a good, or decent grade otherwise it's really difficult tbh. Overall, you need to work really hard to get even a B from him for this course.

I have heard lots of negative reviews about him. Usually my experience comes out the opposite of these reviews and the same goes for him.
From my experience Sir is very knowledgeable, passionate about teaching, takes interesting classes as well. No doubt you will learn a lot from his classes. I would suggest not to worry much about grades and take his cours… See more

He is the best. He teaches really well and I didn't find him boring. He is a good man. Student friendly if you communicate and don't take him for granted.
His questions are tricky. He loves to ask conceptual questions. So the best way to obtain good marks and grade is to understand the concepts rather then memorizing slides.
He prefers fresh perspective. So, do your best to answer his questions your way but make sure the answers are on point and not copied from others.
Be attentive, attend all the quiz, viva and submit assignments in due time, you'll be just fine.
If you are honest, NQH sir is the kindest and most helpful person you'll find in NSU.

sti.review:
Md. Assaduzzaman Reyan
A তো বহুকাল যাবৎ চোখেই দেখি না!
You should advise 498R only when you’ve selected the project, talked about it with a faculty and decided your team. I don’t think people usually advise 498R and then find out what to do

The process is simple, you speak with a faculty about your idea with your team, suppose this semester. You iron some details, do a meeting or two, then next semester you advise 498R. You would then collect a form from the help desk, fill it out, take a signature from your decided faculty and submit it afterwards to the main TA room officer (I believe his name is Farid sir). Then you are set to be working.
To remain multiple steps ahead, you could contact your faculty of choice, with the fixed idea, start working without advising 498R. When your work is near to the end you feel, or you are about to do 499B/ your last semester, advise it for that semester and then finish it within 1. Hassle free, most efficient way to do it.
